# Power BI check values

*Generated by `scripts/powerbi_checks.py` from the Parquet files in `powerbi/data/`. Do not edit by hand.*

Once the measures are in the model, run the `EVALUATE` queries at the end of [`measures.dax`](measures.dax) in DAX query view and compare. The DAX results also show their sort columns (`quarter_key`, `peer_group_sort`, `triage_key`). Rates are shown to two decimal places; Power BI's numbers should match to the last digit shown. Each value here is computed from the Parquet files with the same logic as the DAX, and tests tie the values to the Python analysis behind the README.

## Does the model rebuild the published figures?

The fact table turns published percentages back into head counts. Adding a hospital's five triage categories up again should give its published all-categories figure, to rounding.

| Quarters published to | Hospital-quarters | 4-hour stays: largest gap (points) | Within tolerance | Admitted share: largest gap (points) |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| one decimal place | 937 | 0.09 | 937 (within 0.1) | 0.08 |
| whole numbers | 520 | 0.83 | 520 (within 1.0) | 0.80 |

## Is a blank a zero?

In 4 quarters some triage categories with attendances have a blank admitted share. In 83 hospital-quarters that happens while the all-categories share is published, so the two readings of the blank can be compared with it (a whole number, so a fit is within 1 point).

| Reading of the blank | Hospital-quarters that rebuild the published share |
| --- | ---: |
| zero (used by the model) | 83 of 83 |
| no data: drop the row | 62 of 83 |

### 7. A blank that means zero (Oct-Dec 2023)

Measure: Admitted %, next to the same sum divided only by rows whose admitted share was not blank, and the published all-categories figure (a whole number in this quarter). Four quarters publish a zero as `-`. The model reads those blanks as 0%; dropping the rows instead would overstate the admitted share.

| hospital_name | attendances | admitted | admitted if blank rows are dropped | published |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Capricorn Coast | 4,662 | 6.97% | 7.58% | 7% |
| Cunnamulla | 407 | 7.85% | 11.37% | 8% |
| Dirranbandi | 235 | 9.83% | 13.05% | 10% |
